messages.content: Predict a real participant's observed decision in a laboratory experiment, without advice or moral evaluation. Bilateral games are played once per role with different randomly matched people for each game; no payoff or partner-choice feedback is given until the experiment is over. Counterpart type and identity are not supplied. One point converts to 0.35 euros. Payoffs from all six bilateral role interactions contribute to earnings; do not assume only one is paid. The 2.50-euro show-up fee is separate. The known bilateral sequence is: Dictator sender, Ultimatum proposer, Trust sender, passive Dictator recipient, Ultimatum responder strategy, Trust receiver strategy. The passive role is not an extra choice. Own earlier decisions below are choices the person already made, not feedback about other players; omitted histories are not asserted to be unknown to the participant. In the Dictator Game, you actively split 10 points: give integer t from 0 to 10 inclusive to the passive recipient and keep 10-t. The recipient cannot reject or return anything. Output only t, the integer points given.
